svg.text: bias_dist_pd: switchable distribution mirror, 4 sourced inputs -> 4 sourced outputs (1 : 1), digital enable en_3v3
Enabled inputs (en_in<k> = 1) add up in NI; NM copies the sum into the PMOS diode PD; each enabled output PO<j> sources it through its TG.
iout<j> feeds a bias_tree_pd (NMOS input diode NI behind its own TG), e.g. one per pad; a disabled output's TG is open and PO<j> carries no current.
en_3v3 = 0: all TGs open, TDN pulls ni to vssh, SVPD pulls vpd to vddh. Devices as in bias_tree_pd (NI 6u/6u, BP 5u/6u, switches 1u/0.45u). Source: netlist/source/bias_dist_pd.spice
Legs: one bdp_slice per input and output (nand2_hv | inv_hv | tg_hv, as the layout cell); en_out<j> and en_3v3 join the output slices by name. [M] [O] analog: mirror, PMOS outputs.
as drawn in the rows (pad convention):
D = S = B on the rail, gate as drawn;
MDP at both ends of PO0 PO1 PD PO2 PO3,
MDN at both ends of NI NM
